metadata.title: Recovering a Riemannian manifold from minimal surface areas
metadata.abstract: We study the recovery of a three-dimensional Riemannian manifold from the areas of minimal surfaces. We show that areas of minimal surfaces determine the metric on manifolds foliated by minimal surfaces, up to boundary-fixing isometry. This resolves the conjecture on boundary rigidity for least-area data in an exterior formulation, even without topological restrictions on the minimal surfaces. We also prove global rigidity for Einstein metrics on compact three-manifolds with boundary, assuming $\(\pi_1(M,\partial M)=0\)$ and a non-trapping condition. The Einstein result includes the

analysis.topic: 几何分析、几何 PDE 与几何流
analysis.workSummary: 证明在极小曲面叶状分解条件下，极小曲面面积数据确定三维流形度量至固定边界的等距。
analysis.breakthrough: 解决所述外部形式最小面积边界刚性猜想，并给出带附加条件的 Einstein 全局刚性。
analysis.limitations: 叶状分解及 Einstein 情形的拓扑、非陷获条件不可省略。
